key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to cut expensive simulator calls while preserving strong optimization performance.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for industrial process design because it can reduce runtime and cost when tuning complex flowsheets with many variables and costly evaluations.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to identify and keep the most influential design variables.
Train a fidelity-augmented Gaussian process to link cheap approximations with expensive high-fidelity simulations.
Apply a cost-aware acquisition rule with cooldown and promotion to balance exploration across fidelities.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—plasmid DNA bioprocessing in SuperPro Designer and green fuel synthesis in Aspen HYSYS—showing fewer high-fidelity evaluations while staying competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on having meaningful low-fidelity models and reliable sensitivity estimates; poor surrogate correlation or misidentified variables could reduce the benefit.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
